must_keep.quote: The return journey , while respecting the principles of minimising the environmental impact and ensuring cost efficiency, must be, in principle, started: ⎯ in the case of travel by air, not more than three-and-a-half hours after the end of the meeting(s); ⎯ in the case of travel by any other means of transport, not more than two hours after the end of the meeting(s).
